parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The internal name used to identify the SFP Cage instance.

parameters.name: SFPPresent
parameters.description: The value {{true}} indicates the presence of an SFP in the SFP Cage instance. The value is always {{true}} for a SFF. Note: A value of 0x02 in {{param|SFF8024Identifier}} will also indicate the presence of an SFF.

parameters.name: SFF8024Identifier
parameters.description: This identifier describes the type of SFP and the management protocol as per "Identifier Value" listed in {{bibref|SFF-8024|Table 4-1}}.

parameters.name: MgmtInterface
parameters.description: This parameter indicates the management interface used by the SFP. Refer {{bibref|SFF-8024|Table 4-1}} and {{bibref|SFF-8472}}.

parameters.name: SFPType
parameters.description: This value is applicable only when {{param|SFPPresent}} is {{true}}. If the SFP Type cannot be classified, the value is reported as "Unsupported".

parameters.name: SFPReference
parameters.description: The path to the SFP management object associated with this interface.

parameters.name: IsAllowed
parameters.description: {{true}} if the CPE allows the SFP, {{false}} if the CPE blocks the SFP. See {{object|#.AllowedSFPs}} for what it means for an SFP to be blocked or allowed. The CPE sets this parameter to {{true}} or {{false}} based on the configuration in: - {{param|#.AllowedSFPs.AllowAllSFPs}} - {{object|#.AllowedSFPs.AllowedSFP}} This parameter is only applicable for pluggable SFPs; it's not applicable for built-in modules/SFPs (the CPE should always allow built-in modules/SFPs). This parameter is also only applicable if {{param|SFPPresent}} is {{true}}.

object.description: This object describes a cage into which an SFP is inserted. This object can also describe an instance of Small Form Factor (SFF) units soldered on to the platform.
